name: QuadrantParticipant
description: Links a Stump participant to a specific Quadrant within a Molecule.

attributes.name: quadrantId
attributes.description: The ID of the Quadrant to which the Stump is linked.

attributes.name: stumpId
attributes.description: The ID of the User (Stump) participant linked to the Quadrant.

attributes.name: moleculeId
attributes.description: The ID of the Molecule this Quadrant-Stump assignment belongs to (denormalized for query efficiency).

attributes.name: assignedByUserId
attributes.description: The ID of the User (Lead Point) who made this assignment.
